#summary Features of EMFStore and their dependencies

The EMFStore framework consists of three features:

  * EMFStore Server Feature (org.unicase.emfstore.server): Contains the plugins required for running the EMFStore server

  * EMFStore Client Feature (org.unicase.emfstore.client): Contains the plugins required to contact the EMFStore server from an EMFStore client

  * EMFStore Client User Interface feature (org.unicase.emfstore.client.ui): Contains all views for EMFStore clients including views to commit, update, merge and show the history of a model.

In a typical deployment scenario conists of an EMFStore Server node and an EMFStore client node. While the server node contains only the EMFStore Server Feature, the client node contains all features.
